basic_info.description: Prime opportunity to own a Top-Floor, 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse at a great price! The main level has a well-kept kitchen that is move-in ready or can be updated to your taste over time. The spacious living and dining area has classic hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, and access to a private patio. A half bath with stacked washer/dryer complete this level.  Downstairs includes two more bathrooms that can function as-is or be transformed into spa-like baths. The primary bedroom has a comfortable window seat and ample closets. The versatile second bedroom has a built-in office and Murphy bed ideal for guests and working from home. The upper level private deck has views of the Bay Bridge, Downtown Skyline and Coit Tower.  Additional feature: Dual-Pane windows throughout! Telegraph Landing has 24-7 doorman/security, onsite management, deeded parking, storage, gym and clubroom.  Ideal North Waterfront location just one block to the Embarcadero and a short walk to the Ferry Building, Financial District and North Beach.
